data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 最终决战
data.description: 【阿尔托莉雅 · 最终决战】崩塌的神殿与焦黑的大地之上，金色星光在剑柄周围狂暴汇聚，狂风呼啸吹卷着蓝色的战裙。骑士王双手高举闪耀天际的光辉圣剑，发出了贯穿天地的浩瀚真名咏唱——「誓约——胜利之剑（Excalibur）！以此一击，彻底斩断前方的全部黑暗！」
data.action: 高举誓约胜利之剑，金光四溢
data.promptProse: Artoria raises Excalibur with both hands in a resolute stance on the final battlefield, her blue armored dress and white underdress pulled by the wind beneath long white gloves. The cowboy view follows the radiant blade upward toward storm clouds above ruined ground. Golden mana illuminates her determined eyes, cuirass and gripping hands, projecting hard-edged rubble shadows as the sword's beam cuts through the darker clouds.
